Title: Add club application system and recruitment workflows

Description:
Allow activities/clubs to create application cycles with questions (free response, multiple choice), committees, and accept/reject flows.

Acceptance criteria:
- `Application`, `ApplicationQuestion`, `ApplicationSubmission` models.
- Support for multiple committees per application and per-committee submissions.
- Word limits, multiple-choice options, and validation.
- Admin review pages and templated acceptance/rejection emails.
